newsitem.title: USA: RG&E sees Ginna nuke shut for up to 4 wks.
newsitem.headline: RG&E sees Ginna nuke shut for up to 4 wks.

text.p: The restart date of Rochester Gas and Electric Corp's (RG&E) 470 megawatt Ginna 1 nuclear generating unit, shut last Wednesday, is still unknown, the company said Monday.
"There's no restart date yet, but it will be up to four weeks," said company spokesman Mike Power.
Plant operators will perform diagnostic testing while the unit is down following last week's discovery of impurities in the oil that is used to cool the plant's transformer, he said.
Ginna, located in Ontario, N.Y., typically produces about half of the utility's power output.
